headline: No scored news; lines drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores moved by only hundredths of a point as the effects of earlier announcements slowly faded. Enslaved God still leads at 36.18, followed by Conquerors at 26.63 and Self-Destruction at 26.15. Horizon Balance stayed at -7.70, unchanged in practice.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Conquerors -0.08 and Zookeeper -0.08.
